asset.name: MessageActions
asset.description: The contextual action group for copy, retry, edit, branch, rate, cite, save, and share, kept out of the way until relevant without becoming hover-only.

requires.reason: Actions and overflow use the shared group.
Individual actions are shared icon controls with accessible names.
Less-common actions collapse into the shared overflow menu.

rationale: The tension is clutter versus reachability. Actions hidden until hover are unreachable on touch and by keyboard, so the contract is progressive disclosure that still has a non-pointer path.
